Remailer Reliability Stats [Test Pinger]

This pinger collects reliability statistics for the Mixmaster (type II) remailers of the yamn network. It also offers the current keyring and each remailer's replies to remailer-conf, remailer-key, remailer-help and remailer-adminkey requests for your convenience.

Available Stats

Out of the 3 Mixmaster remailers on these stats there is 1 remailer over 98.0% in terms of overall reliability.
